Wayfare

A mobile travel app that puts discovery, attraction details, weather and trip planning behind one interactive globe: explore a place, judge one attraction, then plan the days.

Try it

  1. On Explore, drag the globe, then search a city such as Rome or Kyoto.
  2. Change the search radius and filter attractions by category.
  3. Tap an attraction to open its page: history, photos, food, parking, tips and weather.
  4. Open Plan to build a day-by-day itinerary and refine it.
  5. Try Live sun to see real day and night on the globe.

Runs on live open data (OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Open-Meteo). Reviews link out to Google, Tripadvisor and Yelp. Verify details before you travel.
